kb.animals.foot and mouth.display_name: Mafu a Maoto le a Molomo
kb.animals.foot and mouth.prevention: Etsa ente ea selemo le selemo ho liphoofolo tsohle tse ka 'nang tsa e-ba teng. Ho thibela ho sisinyeha ha liphoofolo, batho le likoloi. Boloka polokeho ea likokoana-hloko e tiileng. Tlaleha linyeoe leha e le life tse belaetsang hang-hang ho DVS.
kb.animals.foot and mouth.q.duration: U 'nile ua hlokomela matšoao ana ka nako e kae?
kb.animals.foot and mouth.q.eating: Na phoofolo eo e ja le ho noa ka tsela e tloaelehileng?
kb.animals.foot and mouth.q.eating.o1: Ho ja ka tlaase ho moo ho tloaelehileng
kb.animals.foot and mouth.q.eating.o2: Ho hana lijo ka ho feletseng
kb.animals.foot and mouth.q.mobility.o0: Ho tsamaea ka tsela e tloaelehileng
kb.animals.foot and mouth.q.mobility.o2: Ho holofala haholo kapa ho se sisinyehe
kb.animals.foot and mouth.q.saliva: Na ho na le ho hlafuna ho feteletseng kapa ho foaming molomong?
kb.animals.foot and mouth.q.saliva.o1: Ho ne ho e-na le ho lutla ho itseng
kb.animals.foot and mouth.q.saliva.o2: Ho hlafuna kapa ho foaming ka matla
kb.animals.foot and mouth.q.spread: Na liphoofolo tse ling tse mohlapeng li na le matšoao a tšoanang?
kb.animals.foot and mouth.q.spread.o1: Batho ba bang ba 1-2 ba amehileng
kb.animals.foot and mouth.q.spread.o2: Liphoofolo tse ngata li ile tsa ameha
kb.animals.foot and mouth.rec.high: HO HLOKAHALA: Ho na le matšoao a matla a lefu la maoto le molomo. Ikarole liphoofolo TSOHLE hang-hang. Bitsa mohala oa tšohanyetso oa DVS hona joale. U se ke ua tsamaisa liphoofolo, likoloi kapa batho pakeng tsa mapolasi. Ena ke lefu la tšohanyetso la naha.
kb.animals.foot and mouth.rec.low: Matšoao a pele a ile a fumanoa. Etsa hore phoofolo ena e arohane le batho ba bang hang-hang e le hore u itšireletse. Lekola ka hloko lihora tse 24 tse tlang. Hlahloba liphoofolo tse ling kaofela bakeng sa matšoao a tšoanang.
kb.animals.foot and mouth.rec.medium: Tšoenyeho e leka-lekaneng. Qoba phoofolo eo hang-hang. Ikopanye le ofisi ea heno ea DVS kapa ea liphoofolo nakong ea lihora tse 24. U se ke ua tlosa liphoofolo leha e le life polasing. FMD ke lefu le lokelang ho tlalehoa, ka molao u tlameha ho le tlalehela.
kb.animals.foot and mouth.spreads_by: Ho kopana ka kotloloho, libaka tse silafetseng, moea
kb.animals.foot and mouth.treatment: Ha ho na pheko e tobileng ea FMD. Kalafo e thusa: hloekisa le ho bolaea likokoana-hloko, ho fana ka lijo tse bonolo le metsi a hloekileng, ho sebelisa meriana e khahlanong le ho ruruha tlas'a tataiso ea ngaka ea liphoofolo le ho boloka liphoofolo li phutholohile.
kb.animals.foot and mouth.visual_symptom: Li-blisters le maqeba mahetleng, molomong, leleme le matsoele. Ho hlafuna ho feteletseng. Ho hlonama.
kb.animals.foot and mouth.when_to_call_v: Bitsa ngaka ea liphoofolo kapa DVS hang-hang. FMD ke lefu le lokelang ho tsebisoa. U se ke ua ema.
kb.animals.goat pox.prevention: Ho entoa selemo le selemo. Qoba liphoofolo tse ncha bonyane libeke tse 3. Qoba ho kopana le mehlape e tšoaelitsoeng. Boloka matlo a hloekile 'me u fokotse ho ata ha batho.
kb.animals.goat pox.q.breathing: Na phoofolo eo e thatafalloa ke ho hema kapa e tsoa ka nko?
kb.animals.goat pox.q.breathing.o0: Ho hema ka tsela e tloaelehileng
kb.animals.goat pox.q.breathing.o1: Ho ne ho e-na le phallo e itseng ka nko.
kb.animals.goat pox.q.breathing.o2: Ho hema ka thata kapa ho tsoa ka matla
kb.animals.goat pox.q.lesion_stage: Likotsi tsa letlalo li shebahala joang?
kb.animals.goat pox.q.lesion_stage.o0: Li-spots tse khubelu tse phahamisitsoeng feela
kb.animals.goat pox.q.lesion_stage.o2: Li-crusted scabs kapa maqeba a bulehileng
kb.animals.goat pox.q.new_animals: Na ho na le liphoofolo tse ncha tse ileng tsa tlisoa mohlapeng oa bona morao tjena?
kb.animals.goat pox.q.new_animals.o1: E, libekeng tse peli tse fetileng
kb.animals.goat pox.rec.high: Ho phatloha ho matla ha tšoaetso ea Pox ea Lipōli. Ho hlokahala tlhahlobo ea tšohanyetso ea bongaka ba liphoofolo. Ikarole mohlape oohle ho batho ba ka ntle. Qala ho enta liphoofolo tse sa ameheng hang-hang. Tsebisa baokameli ba tsa bongaka ba liphoofolo ba sebakeng seo.
kb.animals.goat pox.rec.low: Likotsi tsa pele-pele. Ikarole phoofolo e amehileng. Lekola lipōli tse ling ka hloko. Ho etsa bonnete ba hore ho na le matlo a hloekileng le ho fokotsa khatello ea kelello e bakiloeng ke liphoofolo.
kb.animals.goat pox.rec.medium: Tšoaetso e sebetsang ea Pox ea Lipōli. Ikarole liphoofolo tsohle tse amehileng. Ikopanye le ngaka ea liphoofolo bakeng sa phekolo ea antiviral le ho enta liphoofolo tse phetseng hantle. Etsa hore matlo le lisebelisoa li se ke tsa silafala. Fokotsa motsamao oa liphoofolo.
kb.animals.goat pox.spreads_by: Ho kopana ka kotloloho, ho tsoa ha moea, thepa e silafetseng
kb.animals.goat pox.treatment: Phekolo e tšehetsang feela. Meriana e khahlanong le vaerase e ka 'na ea laeloa ke ngaka ea liphoofolo. Hloekisa le ho bolaea likokoana-hloko letsatsi le leng le le leng. Fana ka phepo e nepahetseng le metsi a hloekileng. Liphoofolo tse nyenyane tse arohaneng le batho ba baholo ha li sa le bana li kotsing e khōlō.
kb.animals.goat pox.visual_symptoms: Maqeba a letlalo a phahametseng libakeng tse se nang moriri; ka hare ho litsebe, mokokotlong, li-armpits, haufi le mahlo le molomo. Maqeba a hlaha ho tloha matheba a khubelu a phahamisitsoeng ho ea ho li-vesicles ho ea ho li-crusted scabs.
kb.animals.goat pox.when_to_call_vet: Ikopanye le ngaka ea liphoofolo nakong ea lihora tse 24. Bitsa hang-hang haeba ho e-na le mathata a ho hema kapa ho e-na le tšoaetso e matla.
kb.animals.healthy.prevention: Etsa ente khafetsa, ho thibela likokoana-hloko, ho thibela likokoana-hloko le ho hlahloba liphoofolo selemo le selemo.
kb.animals.healthy.rec.low: Phoofolo ea hao e bonahala e phetse hantle! Fana ka metsi a hloekileng, phepo e leka-lekaneng le ho laola likokoana-hloko khafetsa (ho senya likokoana-hloko, ho phekola litoeba). Boloka liente li le nakong 'me u hlophise tlhahlobo ea kamehla ea liphoofolo likhoeli tse ling le tse ling tse 6.
kb.animals.healthy.visual_symptoms: Ha ho matšoao a lefu a fumanoeng. Phoofolo e bonahala e phetse hantle.
kb.animals.healthy.when_to_call_vet: Hlahisa tlhahlobo ea letsatsi le letsatsi likhoeli tse ling le tse ling tse tšeletseng. Bitsa hang-hang haeba u hlokomela liphetoho tse sa lebelloang boitšoarong, lijong, tsamaisong kapa ponahalong.
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.display_nam: Lefu la Letlalo le Nang le Lumpy
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.prevention: Ente ea selemo le selemo e nang le ente e ngolisitsoeng ea LSD. Boloka mananeo a ho laola likokoanyana. Ho arola liphoofolo tse ncha ka matsatsi a 28. Qoba ho tsamaisa liphoofolo nakong ea mafu a seoa.
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.q.fever: Na phoofolo eo e ikutloa e chesa ho e ama kapa e bonahala e na le feberu?
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.q.fever.o0: Ha ho na matšoao a feberu
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.q.fever.o2: Ho hlakile hore o na le feberu ebile o lieha ho robala
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.q.insects: Na u hlokometse likokoanyana tse ngata haufi le liphoofolo tsa hao morao tjena?
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.q.insects.o: Ha ho likokoanyana tse sa tloaelehang
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.q.milk: Na tlhahiso ea lebese e fokotsehile haholo?
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.q.milk.o2: Ho theoha ho hoholo kapa ho emisa ka ho feletseng
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.q.nodules_s: Ho pholletsa le ' mele ho akarelletsa le sefahleho le maoto
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.rec.high: Ho hlahisoa ha lefu le matla la letlalo le nang le makhopho. Ho hlokahala tlhahlobo ea bongaka ba liphoofolo hang-hang. Ikarole liphoofolo tsohle tse amehileng. Qala ho laola likokoanyana ka mabifi polasing. Etsa ente ea liphoofolo tse sa ameheng. Tokomana le ho nka lifoto tsa linyeoe tsohle.
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.rec.low: Ho fumanoe li-nodule tse bonolo. Qoba phoofolo 'me u e shebe letsatsi le leng le le leng. Sebelisa lithethefatsi tse thibelang likokoanyana ho liphoofolo tsohle. Hlahloba likhomo tse ling bakeng sa li-nodule tse tšoanang. Ikopanye le ngaka ea liphoofolo haeba matšoao a mpefala nakong ea lihora tse 48.
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.rec.medium: Li-nodule tse ngata tse nang le liphetoho tsa boitšoaro. Ikarole hang-hang. Qala tlhokomelo ea tšehetso, meriana e khahlanong le ho ruruha, tlhokomelo ea maqeba bakeng sa li-nodule tse bulehileng, taolo ea lintsintsi. Ikopanye le ngaka ea liphoofolo nakong ea lihora tse 24 e le hore u fumane bopaki ba lefu lena le moralo oa phekolo.
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.spreads_by: Ho loma likokoanyana (likokoanyana, lintsintsi, li-ticks), ho kopana le tsona ka kotloloho
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.treatment: Ha ho na phekolo e khethehileng ea antiviral. Tlhokomelo e tšehetsang e kenyelletsa: meriana e thibelang ho ruruha, lithibela-mafu ho thibela tšoaetso ea bobeli, ho roala maqeba bakeng sa li-nodule tse bulehileng le phepo e nepahetseng. Ho laola likokoanyana ke habohlokoa e le hore ho thibeloe ho ata ha tsona.
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.visual_symp: Li-nodule tsa letlalo tse chitja tse phahamisitsoeng tse 2-5 cm 'meleng oohle. Li-nodule li ka 'na tsa lla ka mokelikeli. Li-lymph nodes tse ruruhileng tse bonahalang molaleng le maotong.
kb.animals.lumpy cow disease.when_to_cal: Ikopanye le ngaka ea liphoofolo nakong ea lihora tse 24. Bitsa hang-hang haeba phoofolo e khaotsa ho ja, e e-ba le feberu e matla, kapa li-nodule li bulehile 'me e tšoaelitsoe.
kb.plants.healthy.prevention: Lula u laola litlama, u shebe litšitšili beke le beke, u etse bonnete ba hore li koaheloa hantle, u sebelise mefuta e hanyetsang ha e le teng, 'me u fetole lijalo ka nako e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe.
kb.plants.healthy.rec.low: Lijalo tsa hao li shebahala li phetse hantle! Tsoela pele ho lekola kamehla. Etsa bonnete ba hore metsi a nosetsoa ka tsela e sa fetoheng, a silafatsoa ka tsela e leka-lekaneng, a phalla hantle 'me a thibeloa. Hlahloba matšoao a likokoanyana le maloetse beke e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe,' me u fetole lijalo ka nako e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe.
kb.plants.healthy.visual_symptoms: Ha ho matšoao a lefu a fumanoeng. Semela se bonahala se phetse hantle ka 'mala o tloaelehileng oa makhasi le kholo ea sona.
kb.plants.healthy.when_to_call_vet: Ikopanye le mosebeletsi oa temo ea atolositsoeng haeba u hlokomela ho ba mosehla, ho ruruha, mabala kapa likotsi tse sa tloaelehang, ho bola kapa tšebetso e kholo ea likokoanyana.
kb.plants.potato late blight.display_nam: Lefu le Tsoelang Pele la Litapole
kb.plants.potato late blight.prevention: Sebelisa litapole tsa peō tse tiisitsoeng, tse se nang mafu. Mefuta ea limela e hanyetsanang le likokoana-hloko. Mobu oa lithaba ka mela ho sireletsa li-tubers tse ntseng li hōla hore li se ke tsa e-ba le li-spore. Sebelisa fungicide ea thibelo pele boemo ba leholimo bo le metsi. Phetoho ea lijalo ea lilemo tse 3 e nang le lijalo tse seng tsa solanaceous.
kb.plants.potato late blight.q.humidity: Boemo ba leholimo bo bile joang bekeng e fetileng?
Ho pholile ka pula kapa phoka ea hoseng
Ho pholile, ho metsi ebile ho na le maru ka matsatsi a 'maloa
kb.plants.potato late blight.q.spread_sp: Maqeba aa ata ka potlako hakae?
Ho hasana ho pholletsa le matsatsi
Ho ata ka potlako ka lihora tse 24 ho isa ho tse 48
kb.plants.potato late blight.q.tuber_aff: Ha u cheka li-tubers, na ho na le ponahalo ea ho bola kapa ho fetoha ha 'mala?
Ha ho na li-tubers tse hlahlojoang kapa tsohle li shebahala li le hantle
Li-tubers tse seng kae tse amehileng
kb.plants.potato late blight.rec.high: SEVERE: Ho hlokahala hore ho etsoe khato e potlakileng. Sebelisa fungicide ea tsamaiso hang-hang, kapa u omise le ho kotula morara pele ho nako ho thibela li-spores hore li se ke tsa fihla li-tubers. Li-tubers li kotuloa feela ha makhasi a se a shoele 'me mobu o omme hanyenyane. U se ke ua boloka li-tubers tse nang le matšoao a ho bola. U se ke ua lema litapole kapa litamati sebakeng sena bonyane ka linako tse peli tsa selemo.
kb.plants.potato late blight.rec.low: Matšoao a pele a lefu la seoa. Sebelisa fungicide e entsoeng ka koporo kapa mancozeb hang-hang. Tlosa makhasi a tšoaetsanoang. Ntlafatsa moea o tsamaeang pakeng tsa limela. Qoba ho nosetsa makhasi ha u a nosetsa. Hlahloba letsatsi le leng le le leng, haholo-holo ka mor'a pula.
kb.plants.potato late blight.rec.medium: Ho phatloha ha litapole ka mor'a nako. Sebelisa fungicide ea tsamaiso (metalaxyl kapa cymoxanil) matsatsi a mang le a mang a 5- 7. Khaotsa ho nosetsa ka holim'a metsi. Tlosa 'me u felise lintho tsohle tsa limela tse tšoaelitsoeng tšimong. Qoba ho kotula li-tubers mobung o mongobo, kaha sena se jala li-spores holim'a li-tubers tse phetseng hantle.
kb.plants.potato late blight.spreads_by: Li-spore tse tlisoang ke moea, metsi a phatlohang, li-tubers tse tšoaetsanoang tsa peo, li-transplant tse tšoaetsanoang
kb.plants.potato late blight.treatment: Li-fungicides tse tšoanang le tsa tomate late blight: metalaxyl, cymoxanil, fenamidone bakeng sa pheko. Mancozeb le chlorothalonil bakeng sa tšireletso ea thibelo. Kamehla chencha lihlahisoa ho thibela ho hanyetsa li-fungicide. Phekola li-tubers tse kotuloang (ho boloka tse omileng, tse fofang hantle) pele li bolokoa ka nako e telele e le hore ho fokotsehe ho ata ha ho bola.
kb.plants.potato late blight.visual_symp: Maqeba a mafura a nang le metsi a lefifi makhasi, hangata a qala ka mahlakoreng a makhasi. Ho na le hlobo e tšoeu e bonahalang ka tlas'a makhasi maemong a mongobo. Ho na le maqeba a lefifi litlamong. Li-tuber li na le 'mele o omileng o bofubelu bo bofubelu ka tlas'a letlalo' me li ka bola ka ho eketsehileng ha li bolokiloe. Limela li ka oa ka mor'a matsatsi a seng makae ka boemo ba leholimo bo metsi.
kb.plants.potato late blight.when_to_cal: Ikopanye hang-hang le mosebeletsi oa mosebetsi oa temo. Litapole tsa morao-rao li ka senya lijalo tsohle, tse nang le makhasi le li-tubers tse bolokiloeng, ka matsatsi a seng makae maemong a pholileng le a mongobo  li sebetsa ka potlako.
kb.plants.sorghum cereal grain mold.prev: Limela tse nang le mefuta e fapaneng ea sorghum e sa keneleng hlobo. Sebelisa fungicide nakong ea lipalesa tse 50%. Kotula ka potlako ha u se u hōlile. Qoba ho lema ka mor'a nako e itseng, e leng se etsang hore kotulo e liehe ho fihlela nakong ea lipula. Etsa bonnete ba hore lijo-thollo li bolokoa hantle.
kb.plants.sorghum cereal grain mold.q.ha: Na kotulo e se e loketse kotulo kapa e se e hōlile?
Ho sa na le libeke tse 2 ho isa ho tse 4 ho tloha ha ho kotuloa
Re itokiselitse ho kotula hona joale
Nako e loketseng ea kotulo e fetile
kb.plants.sorghum cereal grain mold.q.mo: Ke karolo e kae ea hlooho ea lijo-thollo e amehileng?
kb.plants.sorghum cereal grain mold.q.we: Boemo ba leholimo bo bile joang nakong ea ho tlatsoa le ho butsoa ha lijo-thollo?
Ho na pula nakong ea lijo-thollo
Pula e na khafetsa le mongobo o phahameng
Sebōpi se matla sa lijo-thollo. Kotulo hang-hang ho sa tsotellehe hore na nako ea eona ea ho butsoa e kae. Litholoana tsa lijo-thollo tse entsoeng ka thata ha li tšoanelehe bakeng sa ho jeoa ke batho kapa lijo tsa liphoofolo ka lebaka la mycotoxins. Ikopanye le katoloso ea temo bakeng sa keletso ea ho lahla lijo-thollo. Fumana mefuta e sa keneleng hlobo bakeng sa sehla se tlang.

Ho ile ha fumanoa matšoao a pele a hlobo. Haeba nako ea kotulo e le haufi, kotula pele ho nako e le hore ho se ke ha ata. Etsa bonnete ba hore moea o potoloha hantle ho potoloha lihlooho tsa lijo-thollo. Sebelisa fungicide haeba lijalo li ntse li le libeke pele li kotuloa 'me maemo a ntse a le metsi.

Sebōpi se itekanetseng sa lijo-thollo. Kotulo kapele kamoo ho ka khonehang  u se ke ua ema. Litholoana tsa lijo-thollo tse kotuloang hang-hang li omisitsoe ho fihlela ka tlase ho 13% mongobo. Arola lijo-thollo tse nang le hlobo le lijo-thollo tse phetseng hantle. U se ke ua fepa liphoofolo lijo-thollo tse bōpiloeng haholo kaha li-micotoxin li ka ba kotsi.
kb.plants.sorghum cereal grain mold.spre: Li-spore tsa li-fungus tse tsamaisoang ke moea le pula, likokoanyana li senya lijo-thollo li etsa hore ho be le libaka tsa ho kena
kb.plants.sorghum cereal grain mold.trea: Hang ha hlobo ea lijo-thollo e se e thehiloe, fungicide e na le phello e fokolang. Tšebeliso ea fungicide ea thibelo nakong ea lipalesa (mohlala, propiconazole) e sebetsa hantle haholo. Ho kotuloa mathoasong a nako ea lipula. Boloka lijo-thollo ka tlaase ho 13% mongobo ho thibela hlobo ka mor'a kotulo.
kb.plants.sorghum cereal grain mold.visu: Ho fetoha ha 'mala o pinki, o mofubelu, o moputsoa kapa o motšo lihloohong tsa lijo-thollo. Litholoana ka bomong tsa lijo-thollo tse senngoeng kapa tse senngoeng ke 'mala. Ho hōla ha li-fungus tse tšoeu kapa tse bohlooho tse bonahalang pakeng tsa li-grain kernel.
kb.plants.sorghum cereal grain mold.when: Ikopanye le ofisiri ea sebaka sa heno ea temo kapa Lefapha la Temo haeba hlobo e ama lijalo tsa hao tse fetang 30% kapa haeba u belaela tšilafalo ea mycotoxin.
kb.plants.tomato late blight.prevention: Sebelisa mefuta ea tomate e sa keneleng metsi. Tšoara limela ho ntlafatsa ho potoloha ha moea. Sebelisa metsi a nosetsang ka marotholi. Sebelisa fungicide ea thibelo pele boemo ba leholimo bo le metsi. Phetoho ea lijalo ea lilemo tse 3 e nang le lijalo tse seng tsa solanaceous.

Litholoana tse seng kae tse nang le maqeba

Ho pholile, ho metsi ebile ho na le maru ka matsatsi a 'maloa

Ho ata ka potlako ka lihora tse 24 ho isa ho tse 48

kb.plants.tomato late blight.visual_symp: Maqeba a mafura a koahetsoeng ke metsi a lefifi makhasi. Ho na le hlobo e tšoeu ka tlas'a makhasi. Ho na le maqeba a sootho a lefifi litlamong. Litholoana li bontša ho bola ho tiileng ho tloha ka ntle ho ea ka hare. Limela li ka oa ka mor'a matsatsi a seng makae.
kb.plants.tomato late blight.when_to_cal: Ikopanye hang-hang le mosebeletsi oa mosebetsi oa temo. Tomate late blight e ka felisa lijalo kaofela ka nako e ka tlaase ho beke maemong a mongobo  sebetsa ka potlako.
kb.plants.watermelon mosaic virus.displa: Kokoana-hloko ea Mosaic ea Semela sa Metsi
kb.plants.watermelon mosaic virus.preven: Mefuta e hanyetsanang le kokoana-hloko ea limela. Sebelisa mulch ea silevera e bonahatsang ho ferekanya li- aphids. Sebelisa lithibela-mafu tse thibelang likokoanyana. Tlosa le ho timetsa mofoka o potileng tšimo. Qoba ho lema haufi le masimo a tšoaetsanoang a li-cucurbit.
kb.plants.watermelon mosaic virus.q.aphi: Na u bona likokoanyana tse nyenyane ka tlas'a makhasi?
Ho hlaseloa ke likokoanyana tse nyenyane
kb.plants.watermelon mosaic virus.q.frui: Litholoana li shebahala joang limela tse amehileng?
Ha ho se ho e-s'o be le litholoana
Litholoana li nyenyane, li senyehile kapa li na le letlalo le khanyang
kb.plants.watermelon mosaic virus.q.leaf: Tsela eo makhasi a feto-fetohang ka 'mala ka eona e shebahala joang?
Ho ba mosehla ka mokhoa o ts'oanang
Mofuta oa mosaic / motsoako o khanyang le o motala o lefifi
Likotsi tse sootho kapa tse ntšo
kb.plants.watermelon mosaic virus.q.plan: Ke limela tse kae tse amehang?
Limela tse seng kae sebakeng se le seng
kb.plants.watermelon mosaic virus.rec.hi: Ho phatloha ho hoholo tšimong. Tlosa 'me u chese limela tsohle tse tšoaelitsoeng. U SE ke ua li silafatsa. Sebelisa likokoanyana tse bolaeang likokoanyana. U se ke ua lema lijalo tsa cucurbit tšimong ena bonyane nako e le 'ngoe. Mohloli oa mefuta e hanyetsanang le kokoana-hloko bakeng sa ho lema hape.
kb.plants.watermelon mosaic virus.rec.lo: Matšoao a pele a kokoana-hloko ea mosaic limela tse seng kae. Tlosa le ho senya makhasi a amehileng. Sebelisa chefo ea likokoanyana ho laola li-aphid vectors. U se ke ua sebetsa limela tse phetseng hantle ka mor'a ho ama tse amehileng ntle le ho hlatsoa matsoho. Lekola limela tse ling letsatsi le letsatsi.
kb.plants.watermelon mosaic virus.rec.me: Kokoana-hloko ea mosaic e hasana ka mokhoa o itekanetseng. Tlosa limela tsohle tse nang le tšoaetso 'me u li felise tšimong. Hlatsoa limela tse setseng ka likokoanyana tse khothalletsoang bakeng sa ho laola li-aphid. U se ke ua lema li-cucurbits sebakeng sena selemong sena. Nahana ka li - mulch tse nahanang ho thibela li - aphids.
kb.plants.watermelon mosaic virus.spread: Likokoanyana tse nang le li-aphid, thepa ea limela e nang le tšoaetso, lisebelisoa tsa ho fetisetsa
kb.plants.watermelon mosaic virus.treatm: Ha ho na pheko ea tšoaetso ea vaerase. Tsamaiso feela: tlosa limela tse tšoaelitsoeng, laola li-aphid vectors ka likokoanyana (mohlala, imidacloprid, pyrethroids), sebelisa li-mulch tse nahanang le mefuta e hanyetsang limela nakong e tlang.
kb.plants.watermelon mosaic virus.visual: Mosaic e mosehla le e mosehla e phatsimang makhasi. Ho sotha ha makhasi le ho kobeha. Litholoana tse nang le 'mala o sa lekanang, boholo bo bonyenyane kapa bokaholimo bo nang le makhopho. Khōlo ea limela e fokotsehile.
kb.plants.watermelon mosaic virus.when_t: Ikopanye le mosebeletsi oa tšebetso ea temo haeba lijalo tsa hao tse fetang 20% li ameha, kapa haeba u hloka thuso ea ho khetholla chefo e nepahetseng ea likokoanyana.
learn.african swine fever.affects: Likolobe (tse ruuoang lapeng le tse hlaha).
learn.african swine fever.prevention: Qoba ho fepa likolobe ka bongata, ho laola motsamao oa likolobe, ho bolaea likokoana-hloko lisebelisoa le likoloi pakeng tsa lipolasi, 'me u tlalehe likolobe tse kulang kapa tse shoeleng hang-hang.
learn.african swine fever.spreads_by: Ho kopana ka kotloloho le likolobe tse nang le tšoaetso, lijo tse silafetseng kapa thepa, li-ticks (li-ticks tse bonolo tsa mofuta oa Ornithodoros) le ho fepa li-swill.
learn.african swine fever.symptoms: Tšoaetso e phahameng, tahlehelo ea takatso ea lijo, mabala a khubelu kapa a purple letlalong, ho hlatsa, letšollo, lefu le sa lebelloang.
learn.african swine fever.what_to_do: Tlaleha hang-hang ho ngaka ea liphoofolo ea naha  ena ke lefu le lokelang ho tsebisoa. Ha ho na pheko kapa ente e amohelehang, kahoo mehlape e amehileng hangata e beheloa ka thoko 'me e bolaoa e le hore e se ke ea ata.
learn.anthrax.affects: Likhomo, linku, lipōli le liphoofolo tse ling tse lekang ho fula. Zoonotic  e ka tšoaetsa batho ka ho kopana le litopo kapa lihlahisoa tse tšoaelitsoeng.
learn.anthrax.prevention: Etsa ente ea liphoofolo tse ruuoang libakeng tse tsejoang hore ke tsa tlhaho, u qobe ho fula naheng e nang le histori ea lefu la anthrax, 'me u felise litopo ka tsela e sireletsehileng le ka potlako.
learn.anthrax.spreads_by: Ho kenngoa ha li-spore tse tsoang mobung o silafetseng kapa makhulo, haholo-holo ka mor'a hore mobu o senyehe kapa likhohola libakeng tse lulang teng.
learn.anthrax.symptoms: Hangata lefu la tšohanyetso ke letšoao la pele; hape le feberu, ho thatafalloa ke ho hema, ho thothomela le ho tsoa mali ka lebaka la ho buloa ha 'mele (nose, molomo, anal) ka mor'a lefu.
learn.anthrax.what_to_do: U SE ke ua bula kapa ua etsa autopsy setopo se belaelloang hore se na le anthrax  sena se tla lokolla li-spore. Tlaleha hang-hang ho ngaka ea liphoofolo bakeng sa netefatso le ho lahla setopo ka mokhoa o sireletsehileng (ho chesoa kapa ho patoa ka botebo ka lime).
learn.blackleg.affects: Likhomo tse nyenyane (likhoeli tse 6 ho isa ho tse 2) haholo-holo; ka linako tse ling linku.
learn.blackleg.prevention: Etsa ente ea likhomo tse nyenyane selemo le selemo libakeng tse nang le histori ea mokokotlo o motšo, 'me u qobe ho fula naheng eo ho eona ho kileng ha e-ba le linyeoe tse fetileng.
learn.blackleg.spreads_by: E bakoa ke libaktheria tsa Clostridium tse tsoang mobung tse kenang ka maqeba kapa tse jeoang; li-spore li ka phela mobung ka lilemo tse ngata.
learn.blackleg.symptoms: Ho holofala ka tšohanyetso, ho ruruha karolong e ka morao kapa lehetleng ho phatlohang ka tlas'a letlalo (khase ka tlas'a letlalo), feberu e phahameng, lefu la tšohanyetso, hangata ho likhomo tse nyenyane tse nang le boemo bo botle.
learn.blackleg.what_to_do: Ikopanye le ngaka ea liphoofolo hang-hang  lithibela-mafu li ka thusa haeba li fumanoa li sa le mathoasong a nako, empa lefu lena le tsoela pele ka potlako 'me hangata lea bolaea. Ho kgothaletswa hore mohlape o setseng o entoe ka mor'a ho phatloha ha seoa.
learn.brucellosis.affects: Likhomo, lipōli, linku le likolobe. E ka boela ea tšoaetsa batho (e tšoaetsanoang ke liphoofolo) ka ho kopana le liphoofolo tse tšoaelitsoeng, mokelikeli oa tsoalo kapa lebese le sa pasteurization.
learn.brucellosis.prevention: Etsa ente ea manamane / masea moo ho nang le lenaneo la naha, etsa liteko 'me u tlose liphoofolo tse tšoaelitsoeng, 'me u etse hore lebese le pasteurise pele le jeoa.
learn.brucellosis.spreads_by: Ho kopana le masea a senyehileng, lesea le sa tsoa tsoaloa le metsi a tsoalo; lebese le silafetseng; ho ikatisa le liphoofolo tse tšoaelitsoeng.
learn.brucellosis.symptoms: Ho ntša mpa qetellong ea bokhachane, ho boloka setloholo, ho fokotseha ha bokhachane, ho ruruha ha manonyeletso; hangata ha ho na matšoao a totobetseng ka ntle ho bokhachane.
learn.brucellosis.what_to_do: Itšehla thajana le liphoofolo tse senyeheloang ke mpa, u qobe ho sebetsana le lintho tse hlahang ka nako ea tsoalo ka matsoho feela, 'me u ikopanye le ngaka ea liphoofolo bakeng sa liteko. Hangata liphoofolo tse tšoaelitsoeng li bolaoa e le karolo ea mananeo a ho laola.
learn.cassava mosaic disease.prevention: Mefuta e hanyetsanang le limela, sebelisa li-cuttings tse hloekileng / tse netefalitsoeng, 'me u laole mefuta ea lintsintsi tse tšoeu.
learn.cassava mosaic disease.spreads_by: Lintsintsi tse tšoeu (Bemisia tabaci) le tšebeliso ea li-cutting tse nang le tšoaetso bakeng sa ho lema.
learn.cassava mosaic disease.symptoms: Mofuta oa mosaic o mosehla o mosehla makhasi, ho senyeha le ho kobeha ha makhasi, ho fokotseha ha kholo ea limela, ho fokotseha ha tlhahiso ea tuber (motso).
learn.cassava mosaic disease.what_to_do: Tlosa le ho timetsa limela tse tšoaelitsoeng. Kamehla fumana thepa ea ho lema (li-cutting) ho tloha setokong se netefalitsoeng se se nang mafu ho e-na le tšimong e tšoaelitsoeng.
learn.foot and mouth.display_name: Mafu a Maoto le a Molomo
learn.foot and mouth.prevention: Ho entoa, ho thibela liphoofolo ho tsamaea, mehato ea polokeho ea likokoana-hloko.
learn.foot and mouth.spreads_by: Ho kopana ka kotloloho, libaka tse silafetseng
learn.foot and mouth.symptoms: Ho na le li-blisters lihloohong, molomong le lelemeng. Ho hlafuna ho feteletseng, ho holofala, ho fokotsa tlhahiso ea lebese.
learn.foot and mouth.what_to_do: Qoba liphoofolo tse amehileng hang-hang. Ikopanye le ofisi ea hao ea bongaka ea liphoofolo kapa ea DVS e haufi. U se ke ua tlosa liphoofolo polasing. Ho tlaleha ho ba boholong  FMD ke lefu le lokelang ho tsebisoa.
learn.goat pox.prevention: Ho entoa selemo le selemo, ho arola liphoofolo tse ncha, ho qoba ho kopana le mehlape e tšoaelitsoeng.
learn.goat pox.spreads_by: Ho kopana ka kotloloho, ho arohana ha phefumoloho
learn.goat pox.symptoms: Ho phahama ha li-nodule tsa letlalo, feberu, ho tsoa ha nko, bothata ba ho hema.
learn.goat pox.urgency: Ho itšehla thajana le ho phekola
learn.goat pox.what_to_do: Ikarole liphoofolo tse amehileng. Ikopanye le ngaka ea liphoofolo bakeng sa phekolo ea antiviral. Etsa ente ea liphoofolo tse phetseng hantle mohlapeng.
learn.groundnut rosette.prevention: Hlahisa limela ka nako ea pele le ka bongata bo phahameng (li-aphids li khetha lijalo tse fokolang, tse lenngoeng morao), sebelisa mefuta e hanyetsang ha e le teng, 'me u laole li-aphid ka likokoana-hloko tse loketseng.
learn.groundnut rosette.spreads_by: Li-aphid (Aphis craccivora), tse fetisetsang kokoana-hloko ha li ntse li fepa; li ka hasana ka potlako tšimong ka libeke tse seng kae feela.
learn.groundnut rosette.symptoms: Limela tse thibetsoeng, tse nang le lihlahla tse nang le mahlaku a senyehileng a ntseng a hōla; makhasi a fetoha mosehla kapa a silafala; ha ho hlahisoe limela tse nyenyane haeba li tšoaelitsoe ha li sa le monyenyane.
learn.groundnut rosette.what_to_do: Tlosa le ho timetsa limela tse tšoaelitsoeng kapele e le hore li ka lieha ho ata. Ha ho na pheko ea lik'hemik'hale ha semela se tšoaelitsoe.
learn.healthy cattle.prevention: Etsa hore liphoofolo li hlahlojoe khafetsa, li entoe 'me li fepe metsi le lijo tse hloekileng.
learn.healthy cattle.symptoms: Ha ho matšoao a lefu a fumanoeng.
learn.healthy cattle.urgency: Ha ho hlokahale hore ho etsoe letho
learn.healthy cattle.what_to_do: Phoofolo ea hao e bonahala e phetse hantle. Tsoela pele ho lekola ka mehla, ho fana ka liente le ho ja hantle.
learn.healthy goat.prevention: Etsa hore liphoofolo li hlahlojoe khafetsa, li entoe 'me li fepe metsi le lijo tse hloekileng.
learn.healthy goat.symptoms: Ha ho matšoao a lefu a fumanoeng.
learn.healthy goat.urgency: Ha ho hlokahale hore ho etsoe letho
learn.healthy goat.what_to_do: Pōli ea hao e bonahala e phetse hantle. Tsoela pele ho lekola ka mehla le mekhoa e metle ea ho lema.
learn.healthy potato.prevention: Ho boloka lijalo li potoloha, ho laola likokoanyana, ho etsa bonnete ba hore li nosetsoa hantle.
learn.healthy potato.symptoms: Ha ho matšoao a lefu a fumanoeng.
learn.healthy potato.urgency: Ha ho hlokahale hore ho etsoe letho
learn.healthy potato.what_to_do: Semela sa hao se bonahala se phetse hantle. Tsoela pele ka ho hlahloba kamehla le ho laola lijalo hantle.
learn.healthy tomato.prevention: Ho boloka lijalo li potoloha, ho laola likokoanyana, ho etsa bonnete ba hore li nosetsoa hantle.
learn.healthy tomato.symptoms: Ha ho matšoao a lefu a fumanoeng.
learn.healthy tomato.urgency: Ha ho hlokahale hore ho etsoe letho
learn.healthy tomato.what_to_do: Semela sa hao se bonahala se phetse hantle. Tsoela pele ka ho hlahloba kamehla le ho laola lijalo hantle.
learn.healthy watermelon.display_name: Semela sa Metsi se Phetseng Hantle
learn.healthy watermelon.prevention: Ho boloka lijalo li potoloha, ho laola likokoanyana, ho etsa bonnete ba hore li nosetsoa hantle.
learn.healthy watermelon.symptoms: Ha ho matšoao a lefu a fumanoeng.
learn.healthy watermelon.urgency: Ha ho hlokahale hore ho etsoe letho
learn.healthy watermelon.what_to_do: Semela sa hao se bonahala se phetse hantle. Tsoela pele ka ho hlahloba kamehla, ho nosetsa le ho etsa manyolo.
learn.heartwater.prevention: Ho laola li-tick kamehla ka ho li qoelisa kapa ho li phekola ka li-acaricide, le ho laola makhulo ho fokotsa palo ea li-tick.
learn.heartwater.spreads_by: Ho loma ha likokoanyana tse nang le tšoaetso (mofuta oa Amblyomma).
learn.heartwater.symptoms: Ho na le feberu e phahameng, ho lahleheloa ke takatso ea lijo, matšoao a methapo a akarelletsang ho potoloha, ho tsamaea ka maoto a phahameng le ho khohlela; ho bokellana ha mokelikeli ho potoloha pelo le matšoafo.
learn.heartwater.what_to_do: Ikopanye le ngaka ea liphoofolo bakeng sa phekolo ea lithibela-mafu (tetracyclines) hang ha matšoao a hlaha  phekolo ea pele e ntlafatsa menyetla ea ho pholoha haholo.
learn.lumpy cow disease.display_name: Lefu la Letlalo le Nang le Lumpy
learn.lumpy cow disease.prevention: Ho entoa selemo le selemo, ho thibela likokoanyana, ho arola liphoofolo tse ncha.
learn.lumpy cow disease.spreads_by: Ho loma likokoanyana (likokoanyana, lintsintsi), ho kopana le tsona ka kotloloho
learn.lumpy cow disease.symptoms: Ho phahama ha li-nodule tsa letlalo 'meleng, feberu, ho tsoa ha mesifa ka nko, ho fokotseha ha tlhahiso ea lebese, ho ruruha ha li-lymph node.
learn.lumpy cow disease.what_to_do: Ikarole liphoofolo tse amehileng. Ikopanye le ngaka ea liphoofolo bakeng sa phekolo e tšehetsang. Etsa ente ea mohlape oohle. Laola likokoanyana tse potileng polasi.
learn.maize streak virus.affects: Poone, 'me ho isa bohōleng bo fokolang limela tse ling tsa lijo-thollo.
learn.maize streak virus.prevention: Jala mefuta ea poone e hanyetsang kapa e mamellang, laola palo ea li-leafhopper, 'me u qobe ho lema ka mekhahlelo haufi le masimo a khale a poone a tšoaelitsoeng.
learn.maize streak virus.spreads_by: Li-leafhoppers (mofuta oa Cicadulina), tse nkang kokoana-hloko e tsoang limela tse tšoaelitsoeng 'me li e jala ha li ntse li ja tse phetseng hantle.
learn.maize streak virus.symptoms: Lithako tse tšesaane, tse robehileng tse mosehla le tse tšoeu tse tsamaeang ka ho latellana le methapo ea makhasi; kholo e fokotsehileng le nts'etsopele e mpe ea cob maemong a matla.
learn.maize streak virus.what_to_do: Tlosa le ho timetsa limela tse nang le tšoaetso e matla moo ho ka khonehang. Ha ho pheko hang ha semela se tšoaelitsoe.
learn.newcastle disease.affects: Likhoho tsa likhoho ke tsona tse kotsing haholo; li ama le linonyana tse ling.
learn.newcastle disease.prevention: Etsa hore mehlape e entoe ka nako e behiloeng, u thibele baeti hore ba se ke ba kena malapeng a likhoho, u thibele ho bolaea likokoana-hloko le ho arola linonyana tse ncha pele li kenngoa mohlapeng.
learn.newcastle disease.spreads_by: Ho kopana ka kotloloho le linonyana tse tšoaetsanoang, likhoerekhoere tse silafetseng, lisebelisoa, lijo, metsi le ho fetisoa ha tsona ka moea libakeng tse khutšoanyane.
learn.newcastle disease.symptoms: Matšoenyeho a ho hema, letšollo le botala, molala o kobehileng kapa ho holofala, ho fokotseha ha tlhahiso ea mahe, lefu le sa lebelloang ha ho e-ba le mafu a matla.
learn.newcastle disease.what_to_do: Hang-hang arola linonyana tse kulang 'me u ikopanye le ngaka ea liphoofolo. Ha ho na phekolo; ho entoa ke mokhoa oa mantlha oa ho laola hang ha ho fumanoa ho phatloha.
learn.potato late blight.display_name: Lefu le Tsoelang Pele la Litapole
learn.potato late blight.prevention: Sebelisa mefuta e hanyetsang, sebelisa fungicide ea thibelo, qoba maemo a metsi.
learn.potato late blight.spreads_by: Li-spore tsa li-fungus tse tsamaisoang ke moea, metsi
learn.potato late blight.symptoms: Mabala a lefifi a nang le metsi makhasi le mahlaku, hlobo e tšoeu karolong e ka tlaase ea makhasi, li-tubers tse bolileng.
learn.potato late blight.what_to_do: Sebelisa fungicide hang-hang. Tlosa 'me u felise semela se tšoaelitsoeng. Qoba ho nosetsa ka holim'a metsi.
learn.sorghum anthracnose.prevention: Mefuta e hanyetsanang le limela, khutlisetsa lijalo hōle le sorghum ka nako e itseng, 'me u qobe ho lema haholo e le hore makhasi a lule a le metsi ka nako e telele.
learn.sorghum anthracnose.spreads_by: Li-spore tsa li-fungus li hasana ka lebaka la moea, pula le lijalo tse setseng tšimong.
learn.sorghum anthracnose.symptoms: Mabala a mafubelu, a sootho kapa a batsho a makhasi a atolosang le ho kopanya; ho fetoha 'mala o mofubelu litlamong; hlobo ea lijo-thollo lihloohong tse nang le tšoaetso maemong a mongobo.
learn.sorghum anthracnose.what_to_do: Tlosa le ho senya masala a lijalo a tšoaetsanoang ka mor'a kotulo. Kalafo ea li-fungicide e ka thusa ha ho e-na le mafu a tebileng  buisana le mookameli oa katoloso bakeng sa lihlahisoa tse amoheloang sebakeng sa heno.
learn.sorghum cereal grain mold.preventi: Sebelisa mefuta e sa keneleng hlobo, qoba ho lieha ho kotula, ntlafatsa metsi a tšimo.
learn.sorghum cereal grain mold.spreads_: Li-spore tsa li-fungus, maemo a mongobo
learn.sorghum cereal grain mold.symptoms: Ho fetoha ha mebala e pinki, e khubelu kapa e ntšo lihloohong tsa lijo-thollo.
learn.sorghum cereal grain mold.what_to_: Ho kotuloa pele ho nako ea ho butsoa ka ho feletseng nakong ea lipula. Lijo li omella kapele ka mor'a kotulo. Sebelisa fungicide haeba e fumanoa pele ho nako.
learn.tomato late blight.prevention: Sebelisa mefuta e hanyetsang, sebelisa fungicide ea thibelo, ntlafatsa ho potoloha ha moea.
learn.tomato late blight.spreads_by: Li-spore tsa li-fungus tse tsamaisoang ke moea, metsi
learn.tomato late blight.symptoms: Mabala a metsi a lefifi makhasi le litholoana, ho hōla ha hlobo e tšoeu, ho putlama ha limela ka potlako.
learn.tomato late blight.what_to_do: Sebelisa fungicide hang-hang. Tlosa 'me u felise semela se tšoaelitsoeng. Qoba ho nosetsa ka holim'a metsi.
learn.watermelon mosaic virus.display_na: Kokoana-hloko ea Mosaic ea Semela sa Metsi
learn.watermelon mosaic virus.prevention: Sebelisa mefuta e hanyetsanang le kokoana-hloko, laola li- aphids, tlosa mofoka tšimong.
learn.watermelon mosaic virus.spreads_by: Li-Aphids, thepa ea limela e nang le tšoaetso
learn.watermelon mosaic virus.symptoms: Mosaic e mosehla le e tala e khabisitsoeng makhasi, litholoana tse sothehileng, kholo e fokotsehileng.
learn.watermelon mosaic virus.what_to_do: Tlosa le ho timetsa limela tse tšoaelitsoeng. Laola li-aphid ka chefo ea likokoanyana. U se ke ua lema li-cucurbits haufi le libaka tse tšoaelitsoeng.
